## Tokens

Background #161513; surface #211f1b; border #454038; accent #ff8a4c;
foreground #f2ebdf. The game uses dark mode only.

## Constraints

### Must

- Warm retro console, charcoal surfaces, orange tactile controls.
- Chakra Petch headings, Space Grotesk body, Space Mono metadata.
- No logo, extra product names, glass effects, or decorative gradients.
- Preserve gameplay and routes; 320px minimum viewport.

### Avoid

- Dense glass panels, decorative gradients, extra branding, tiny mobile targets.

## Decisions

- Use the user's warm retro direction and existing components. Public 21st Retro
  Button and Indie Bytes terminal panels were collected as references; the MCP
  catalog was unavailable. See docs/RETRO-UI.md for sources and verification.
